messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: automatic alert - spike in 5xxs and abnormal KV cache memory on kv-pool nodes. Auto-pager triggered at 02:42 UTC. https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-2321 :rotating_light:

miguel: I'm taking oncall. looking at alerts + logs now. Any visible customer impact?

support-lead: multiple customers getting 502/503. AcmeFoods and BetaRetail highest. Approx 8% error rate across v1/generate in last 12m. CS is already triaging.

jia: correlating with continuous batching rollout around 02:30 UTC. We have a new KV reuse path that may be returning stale seq offsets when pages roll over.

miguel: mitigation plan: 1) disable KV reuse flag on runtime 2) lower batching window 3) restart affected runtime pools. executing now.

kati: applying flag: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/hosts/kv-pool/flags -d '{"KV_REUSE_ENABLED":"false"}'` -> applied to cluster-a,b,d. cluster-c timed out, retrying.

ops-bot: rollout status: cluster-a OK, cluster-b OK, cluster-c TIMEOUT. (ops-bot)

miguel: Jia, can you safe-restart cluster-c runtime processes? Use graceful drain.

jia: running `./scripts/safe-restart --pool kv-pool-c --grace 60` -> "drain started, 3/10 connections remaining"

miguel: also setting `continuous_batching.window_ms=20` and `continuous_batching.max_batch=32` to reduce cross-request packing.

alan: lowering window may increase cost but reduces chance of pointer reuse. fine for hotfix.

support-lead: customer impact summary: AcmeFoods ~75 errors, BetaRetail ~42, self-serve API keys ~1200 bad requests. CS notified AcmeFoods + BetaRetail and opened escalations.

kati: collecting heap/dump from an affected worker: `/opt/redwood/bin/dump-kv-state --pid 9876 > /tmp/kv-dump-9876.json`

jia: dump shows kv entries with seq_offsets that don't match request seqs, clear cross-request leakage. snippet: ```json
{"kv_entries": [{"key":"ctx-usr-42","seq_offset":1234,"value":"..."},{"key":"ctx-usr-43","seq_offset":56,"value":"..."}] }
```

miguel: hypothesis: reuse logic reassigns KV cache handles without resetting per-request seq_base when a paged request finishes. Under high packing, later requests pick up stale seqs -> wrong token slices -> 5xxs.

alan: reproduced locally with mixed short + paged long chat load, failure rate ~1/5000. PoC patch: call `kv_handle.reset_for_request(seq_base)` on reuse.

jia: opened PR #4217 with hotfix, CI passed. Plan: canary to 10% then ramp. since KV_REUSE was disabled, risk is low.

miguel: initiate canary now. Kati, kick off.

kati: `deploy canary kv-runtime@hotfix-4217 --pool kv-pool-a --percent 10` -> deployed.

ops-bot: canary metrics: errors steady ~1.0%, p95 latency normalized, CPU ok.

support-lead: recommend customer message: "We've identified and mitigated a cache reuse bug causing intermittent 5xxs. Hotfix deployed; monitoring continues."

miguel: post-incident actions: 1) add unit/fuzz tests for kv handle reuse 2) telemetry for seq_offset mismatches 3) revisit default batching window for mixed workloads. assigning postmortem -> @jia.

miguel: handing off on-call to @kate_s at 08:00 UTC. I'll remain available. :thumbsup:

kate_s: ack handoff, will monitor overnight.

incident-bot: incident resolved - service restored at 03:45 UTC. Creating incident report INC-2321. :white_check_mark:
